decompiler_artifacts: 00737ab0 writes the slot index into a local that nothing reads. The decompiler folds it into the saved exception-list slot and emits ExceptionList = pvVar1; the assembly restores from [ESP+14h] at 00737bb1.
Ghidra types 00be3640 as a plain function whose param_1 is the stack slot, hiding the ECX profiler pointer that the call sites load.
uncertainties: Input action index 0Eh is unnamed; the table built by 00a93da0 was not opened.
Game states 1, 2 and 4 remain unnamed; they are treated only as the mission set that the close policy also uses.
The unit of the scale at 0109db48 and the meaning of the bias at 00d7a270 are unproven, so the profiler's output unit is not established.
The 0Fh argument passed with each counter name to 00408720 is unexplained.
004e4a40 has an eight-byte stored Ghidra body, so its consumption of application+18h and +19h and the render and present phases inside it were not traced here.
SEH handler 00c86228 was not disassembled; the scope-guard reading rests on the trylevel transitions at 00737ac3 and 00737b90.
No writer other than the constructor was found for application+18h, so a re-arm path cannot be excluded.

cpp.claim: Semantic projection of the frame order onto an injected ApplicationFrameHost, one method per native call site. Not ABI compatible: the native routine takes the application in ECX, returns nothing and reads its subsystems from globals. The interval conversion reuses timestamp_seconds_x87 so it keeps the native FILD/FILD/FDIVP result.
